create_job_config: create a JobConfig dataclass instance with run_name, device_type, seed, and scheduler settings for a FairChem job
configure_slurm_scheduler: configure a SchedulerConfig with SlurmConfig to set mem_gb, timeout_hr, cpus_per_task, and partition for SLURM jobs
configure_ray_cluster: configure a SchedulerConfig with RayClusterConfig to set head_gpus for launching a Ray cluster on SLURM
review_job_metadata: review the Metadata dataclass fields including commit, log_dir, checkpoint_dir, results_dir, and cluster_name auto-populated by JobConfig
summarize_scheduler_types: summarize the SchedulerType, DeviceType, RunType, and DistributedInitMethod enums used to configure FairChem job execution
